name: Dallas County Tax Office
notes: Researched from public dallascounty.org pages only. Moved from the paymentus family to property-tax: the Property Tax Lookup/Payment Application is a parcel/account search with Paymentus as processor. Fees: ACH $0.00; credit card and digital wallets 2.05% with a $2.85 minimum; debit card flat $2.85 (minimum and debit flat fee not expressible, 2.05% used). Pay by phone 1-877-253-0150. eStatement enrollment is per account (search, open account, eStatement button), open November 1 through September 15. Partial payments apply pro-rata to tax, penalty, interest and collection penalty. No automatic payment program is listed. No public sign-in for the lookup; email sign-in is synthetic. Review 2 (2026-10-09): the taxoffice.dallascounty.org help center now loads publicly; its payment-arrangement article says plans are self-enrolled online from the account's payment plan options tab (quarter pay for over-65/disabled homesteads, homestead and non-homestead agreements subject to approval), so payment_arrangement is supported with that note and a help article; Customer Care Center 214-653-7811 set as contact. The mock plan form offers 3/6/12 months, not the real plan types (template limit).

sources.title: Pay Property Tax - Dallas County Tax Office

guest_pay.note: Look up the account in the Property Tax Lookup/Payment Application and pay; ACH is free.

paperless.note: Enroll each account in eStatements from its property page, November 1 through September 15.

autopay.note: No automatic payment program is offered. Pay online, by phone, by mail or in person each year.

pay_by_phone.note: Card payments; debit and credit processing fees apply.

payment_arrangement.note: Open your account in the Property Tax Lookup/Payment Application and choose the payment plan options tab to see the plans you can self-enroll in: quarter pay for over-65, disabled or disabled-veteran homesteads, and homestead or non-homestead payment agreements (subject to approval).

help.title: Payment methods and fees
paragraphs: Pay online through the Property Tax Lookup/Payment Application. ACH (eCheck) payments are free. Credit cards and digital wallets (PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Venmo) cost 2.05% of the amount, at least $2.85; debit cards cost a flat $2.85. The card processor collects these fees and they are not refundable.

To pay by phone, call 1 (877) 253-0150; card fees apply. For questions, the Customer Care Center is at 214-653-7811, and the downtown office is in the Records Building, 500 Elm Street, Suite 3300, Dallas.
Unpaid balances are charged penalties and interest. A partial payment is spread pro-rata across tax, penalty, interest and any collection penalty.

help.title: Electronic property tax statements
paragraphs: To get statements electronically, search for your property, click the blue account number to open it, then click the eStatement enrollment button.
Enrollment is open from November 1 through September 15 each year.

help.title: Payment plan options
paragraphs: Statements are mailed in October; taxes are due on receipt and become delinquent after January 31, when state law adds penalty and interest. Partial payments in any amount are accepted at any time, and only the unpaid balance accrues penalty and interest; partial payments on delinquent taxes go to the oldest year first.

To see the plans open to your account, find it in the Property Tax Lookup/Payment Application, select it and open the payment plan options tab. Homesteads with an over-65, disabled or disabled-veteran exemption can use quarter pay: four equal payments due January 31, March 31, May 31 and July 31, with no penalty or interest if the first quarter is paid before the delinquency date.

Homestead and non-homestead payment agreements spread taxes plus accrued penalty and interest over installments. They need approval and depend on the first payment and every later payment arriving on time; the county's collection firm handles questions about them.
